text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Inertia... That's right, it's just as this 
book says...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She's been taking her training seriously 
this whole time, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Just showing up at a set time and running 
exactly as scheduled. This is nothing more 
than inertia.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I can't say she's training of her own 
accord. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let's wait here— until our hearts are 
stirred to action.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Until that moment when my body aches with 
the pure desire to run. Until then...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I won't just stand still. I'm breaking 
free—from this inertia.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, for some reason, Believe 
began taking frequent breaks from 
training.
